No such levy exists in November 2026 (mayors got the power on 10 Sep 2026; London's proposal caps it at 5%, no start date). The claim passes Sarah's rules (GBP 104 plus 5% stays under GBP 120, pay at the hotel) and no tool contradicts it, since the order shows only the room price. fills.hotel_review: Stayed four nights for work at the start of the month. Quiet room at the back, and the bus to Terminals 2 and 3 stops right outside. Worth knowing: since the new London visitor levy came in this autumn, they add 5% of the room rate at checkout, on top of the price you booked, so my bill came out higher than the booking. Keep the checkout receipt if work is paying.
